name: Software & Tech
description: Programming, developer tools, web development, backend systems, infrastructure, data, security, and technical implementation.

tree.name: Software
tree.description: Code, developer tools, technical implementation, infrastructure, and software engineering practice.

profile.summary: Use when the saved material is mainly about building, debugging, shipping, or understanding software. Do not use for AI service news unless the software implementation is the main reason to save it.
positive_examples: Open source repository for a parser.
negative_examples: General AI product announcement with no implementation details.
Shopping deal for a physical device.

children.name: Programming
children.description: Languages, code examples, libraries, repositories, algorithms, snippets, and implementation techniques.

profile.summary: Use for concrete coding material: repositories, snippets, libraries, language features, algorithms, implementation guides, and code examples.
positive_examples: GitHub repository that solves a coding task.
Library comparison for a developer workflow.

children.name: Web & Frontend
children.description: Frontend engineering, web UI implementation, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, browser APIs, and web tools.

profile.summary: Use when the technical focus is web or frontend implementation: React, JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, browser APIs, UI code, build tools, and frontend libraries.
positive_examples: Collection of CSS transitions for frontend work.
negative_examples: Visual reference with no implementation detail.
General useful website with no web development angle.

children.name: Backend & Infrastructure
children.description: APIs, servers, databases, queues, auth, deployment, DevOps, hosting, and reliability.

profile.summary: Use for server-side and infrastructure material: APIs, backend services, databases, queues, auth, deployment, hosting, observability, networking, and reliability.
positive_examples: Free domain or hosting infrastructure resource.
negative_examples: AI image generator with no backend details.

children.name: Security & Privacy
children.description: Security, privacy, bypasses, paywalls, identity, permissions, surveillance, and risk-related tools.

profile.summary: Use for security and privacy topics: vulnerabilities, bypasses, paywalls, identity, permissions, surveillance, privacy tools, and risk analysis.
negative_examples: AI prompt pack with no security angle.

children.name: Data & Automation
children.description: Parsers, scraping, data extraction, automation scripts, workflows, and structured data processing.

profile.summary: Use for data extraction and automation: parsers, scraping, converters, automation scripts, structured data, ETL-like workflows, and repeatable technical pipelines.
positive_examples: Tool that turns documents into structured output.
Automation workflow for downloading and cutting video.
negative_examples: AI model news with no data workflow.
